value.rationale: Motivated by the exactness-vs-approximation distinction in a central 2026 Horn-program decomposition theorem. The result completely classifies context-preserving rulewise Krom projections, proves universal least-model faithfulness without minimalism, and gives an optimal finite obstruction cutoff in terms of natural clause width. These statements address robust program replacement for prescribed input facts and are not arbitrary small counts.
